proposed.explanation: This describes a suspension or cable-stayed system. This describes a post-and-beam (trabeated) system. While arches produce lateral thrust at supports, the form itself is designed to minimize internal bending through its geometry. Arches and vault systems are curved forms in which loads are distributed primarily through compression along the curve. This compression-dominated behavior is highly efficient and allows large spans (40–200+ m) without significant bending moments. Arches convert vertical loads into compressive forces along their curve.
